Q01.why: no column holds closure_contacts (2 of 3 match)
Q01.sql:
WITH closure_calls AS (
  SELECT
    site_id,
    COUNT(*) AS closure_call_count
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.fct_calls`
  WHERE is_account_closure_call
  GROUP BY site_id
),
site_cost_last_year AS (
  SELECT
    site_id,
    SUM(total_expense) AS total_expense_2025
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.fct_cc_site_cost_monthly`
  WHERE month_start >= '2025-01-01' AND month_start <= '2025-12-01'
  GROUP BY site_id
)
SELECT
  s.site_id,
  s.site_name,
  s.is_outsourced,
  COALESCE(cc.closure_call_count, 0) AS closure_calls,
  COALESCE(cost.total_expense_2025, 0) AS total_expense_2025
FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.dim_cc_site` AS s
LEFT JOIN closure_calls AS cc ON s.site_id = cc.site_id
LEFT JOIN site_cost_last_year AS cost ON s.site_id = cost.site_id
ORDER BY closure_calls DESC;

Q02.sql:
WITH latest_score AS (
  SELECT MAX(score_date) AS max_date
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.ml_scores.churn_score_v3`
)
SELECT
  c.segment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_key) AS high_balance_customers,
  AVG(s.churn_probability) AS avg_churn_probability,
  COUNTIF(s.risk_band = 'HIGH') AS high_risk_customers,
  COUNTIF(s.risk_band = 'HIGH') / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_key) AS high_risk_rate
FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_customer` c
JOIN `fennmoor-dw.ml_scores.churn_score_v3` s
  ON c.customer_key = s.customer_key
JOIN `fennmoor-dw.ml_features.feat_customer_daily` f
  ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key
CROSS JOIN latest_score
WHERE s.score_date = latest_score.max_date
  AND f.as_of_date = s.score_date
  AND f.avg_balance_30d >= 100000
GROUP BY c.segment
ORDER BY avg_churn_probability DESC

Q09.why: no column holds delinquency_rate (2 of 3 match)
Q09.sql:
WITH OPEN_LOANS AS (
  SELECT
    PRODUCT_CODE,
    BRANCH_ID,
    COUNT(*) AS N
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_account`
  WHERE ACCOUNT_FAMILY = 'LOAN'
    AND IS_OPEN
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
DLQ AS (
  SELECT
    A.PRODUCT_CODE,
    A.BRANCH_ID,
    COUNT(*) AS D
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_risk.fct_delinquency_daily` DD
  JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_account` A USING (ACCOUNT_KEY)
  WHERE DD.SNAPSHOT_DATE = (SELECT MAX(SNAPSHOT_DATE) FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_risk.fct_delinquency_daily`)
    AND DD.DPD >= 30
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  O.PRODUCT_CODE,
  B.BRANCH_NAME,
  O.N AS OPEN_LOANS,
  COALESCE(DLQ.D, 0) AS DELINQUENT_LOANS,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(DLQ.D, 0), O.N) AS DELINQUENCY_RATE
FROM OPEN_LOANS O
LEFT JOIN DLQ USING (PRODUCT_CODE, BRANCH_ID)
LEFT JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_branch` B ON B.BRANCH_ID = O.BRANCH_ID
ORDER BY DELINQUENCY_RATE DESC
